name: Reset the posture
description: Return to the home posture: fingers open, arm folded, torso up, waist straight, by a collision-checked joint-space move. Used to recover from an unknown arm state.

precheck.name: hand_empty
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

verifier.name: arm_stowed
verifier.meaning: The arm is folded at its travel posture.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.name: torso_raised
verifier.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its highest position (travel height).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.name: waist_straight
verifier.meaning: Waist pitch within 0.05 rad of upright.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving
